verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for an AI coding agent, but OpenCode's docs in the pack never mention a telemetry setting or opt-out. A community report states OpenCode sends telemetry to its own servers, even with locally hosted models, and that no environment variable, flag or config option disables it. With no vendor claim to contradict, this is an absence of the capability, not a dispute.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
